metadata.case_name: SINGH INDERJEET v. HO CHUN BONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Daytime construction worker (with "Yuen Kwong"); evening delivery worker of ready meals (pizza delivery)

injuries.description: mild posterior L4/5 disc bulge / prolapsed disc in the lumbar spine
source: The worst feature of the back injury was a “mild posterior L4/5 disc bulge”.

the diagnosis of prolapsed disc in the lumbar spine and soft tissue injury in the neck is consistent with the type of injuries sustained … the permanent impairment of the whole person for the satisfactorily resolved lower lumbar disc prolapse is 5%.
injuries.icd_description: Certain specified injuries of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the neck
source: the diagnosis for the neck “remained at soft issue level”.

the diagnosis of prolapsed disc in the lumbar spine and soft tissue injury in the neck is consistent with the type of injuries sustained … the permanent impairment of the whole person for the satisfactorily resolved lower lumbar disc prolapse is 5%. The permanent impairment of the whole person for the soft tissue injury of the neck is 2%.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: abrasions to many parts of his body / multiple abrasions
source: He sustained abrasions to many parts of his body

injuries.description: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) and Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
source: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (“PTSD”) and Major Depressive Disorder (“MDD”), both as a result of the accident.
His current psychiatric complaints are depressive mood, suicidal ideas, impairment of sleep, memory and concentration.
his “scooter phobia” may well be permanent.

manifestations.description: neck pain (worse when tired; sometimes radiates to the head causing headaches)
reduced ability to work / loss of earning capacity

treatments_received: detained overnight at the Queen Mary Hospital
attended by a doctor (not until 11 p.m.)

losses.description: Impairment of sleep, memory and concentration
Unable to return to pre-accident work; loss of evening employment due to scooter phobia; reduced earning capacity
